boost.title: Boosts
boost.stackNote: Boosts stack — buying again adds {{hours}} hrs on top

info.listText: View all your in-game friends. Tap a friend to visit their profile and see their tower stats.
info.requestsText: Accept or reject incoming friend requests. The badge on the tab shows how many requests are waiting.
info.removeText: You can remove a friend at any time from the friends list.
info.addText: To send a friend request, visit any player's profile and tap 'Add Friend'.

mail.title: My Mail
mail.emptySubtitle: When someone sends you a message it'll show up here
mail.emptySentSubtitle: Messages you send to other players will appear here

info.inboxText: Receive messages from any player in the game. Messages are sorted from newest to oldest.
info.unreadText: Unread messages are highlighted in green. Tap a message to open and read it — it will be marked as read automatically.
info.deleteText: You can delete any message after reading it. Deletion is permanent.
info.costText: Sending a message to another player costs 100 coins. Find any player's profile to send them a message.

autopark.title: Autopark
autopark.tagline: Machines allow you to earn more and develop faster

info.whatText: The autopark is a fleet of vehicles that passively boost your hotel's performance. Each vehicle type provides a unique bonus — buy up to 10 of each.
info.truckText: Each armored truck increases base production profit by +5% and base XP by +10%. These bonuses apply before all other multipliers.
info.speedText: Forklifts reduce sell time by 1% each. Delivery trucks reduce delivery time by 1% each. Both also give +5,000 XP per action.
info.lobbyText: Taxis add +1 free gem exchange per day and +1,000 XP per visitor. Buses add +5 visitor slots and +5% tip income each.

referrals.shareMessage:

referrals.empty:

info.codeText: Share your unique code or link with friends. They enter it when registering to link you as their referrer.
info.milestoneText: Earn coins when your friend registers, and gems when they reach level 10 or level 30.
info.purchaseText: You receive a gem bonus whenever a player you referred makes an in-game purchase.
info.haveCodeText: If someone shared a code with you, tap the section below to enter it — both players receive a bonus.

chat.title: Chat
chat.guestBanner: Log in to chat with other players
chat.cooldown: Please wait before sending another message
chat.deleteConfirmBody: This will permanently remove your message.
chat.infoGlobal: Visible to all players around the world, regardless of country.
chat.infoCountry: Only players from your country see these messages. Your country is detected automatically from your device.
chat.infoEdit: Long press any of your messages to edit or delete it.
chat.infoCooldown: You can send one message every 3 seconds.
chat.infoExpiry: All messages are automatically deleted after 24 hours.

city.title: City
city.tagline: A City is all about community!
city.description: Players in a city communicate and help each other.
city.bonusDescription: All city members receive free bonuses that boost revenue and experience!
city.requirementDescription: Cities accept players who have built 10 or more floors.
city.joinDescription: Submit a request and you'll be invited by the city's mayor.
city.rankingsDescription: Or find a city in the rankings and leave a request on the city forum.
city.createDescription: Create your own city and become its Mayor!

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.description: Track your progress across all achievement categories. Each level you complete earns gems and a permanent income or XP bonus.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.description: Invite friends to play. You earn rewards when they register, reach level 10, or level 30, and a bonus whenever referred players make in-game purchases.

myBusiness.title: My Business
myBusiness.description: View your unlocked floor types and upgrade their revenue bonus by spending tokens. Each upgrade adds +5% to earnings for that business category.

dailyTasks.title: Daily Tasks
dailyTasks.description: Complete 9 daily challenges — buy, list, collect goods, lift visitors, and more — to earn coins, building materials, and tokens. Resets every day at midnight.
